title: J.J. McCarthy, Cam Skattebo connect for Giants' 27-21 OT win against Texans

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: J.J. McCarthy, Cam Skattebo connect for Giants' 27-21 OT win against Texans
sources.description: After several weeks of uncertainty in the Giants' QB and RB rooms, J.J. McCarthy and Cam Skattebo powered New York to 27-21 overtime win against the Houston Texans in Week 7.
